partitions.visibility: held out from arm selection; score only after a selection artifact is frozen

legacy_exclusion.claim: Legacy windows may be reused for public search because metric sampling and source-only arms are outcome-blind. They cannot serve as a new confirmation panel.

separation_rule: Search and validation are item/source-group disjoint. Practice outcomes are absent. Validation is the sealed confirmation partition for this breadth search/selection DAG and may be opened only after the selection artifact and production release gate are frozen; any later replication must exclude both partitions.
sampling_estimand: Within each partition, visit one eligible source group before taking a second item from any touched group; deterministic hash order is used when it preserves later-fold capacity, otherwise the smallest future-opportunity groups are consumed first with hash tie-breaking. Touched groups are wholly reserved to one partition.
